title: Print Defect Diagnoser
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics
description: Read about five common 3D print faults, each with what you see, its usual cause and its usual remedy. Then read eight descriptions of failed prints and decide which fault each one is. Used in Chapter 7.

educational.topic: Print quality inspection and common FDM print faults
learningObjectives: Distinguish five common FDM print faults from eight written descriptions of failed prints, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Classify unlabeled symptom descriptions into fault categories, with an explanation of the deciding evidence after each choice
keyQuestions: Which feature of the description separates this fault from the others?
What is the usual cause, and what would you change before printing again?
commonMisconceptions: Every print failure comes from the settings
Stringing and under-extrusion are the same fault
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed choices, one attempt each; 7 of 8 for mastery; the final screen lists the faults that were missed

controls.label: Warping / Stringing / Under-extrusion / Layer shift / Poor first layer
